formula.response: The partial derivative measures how f changes as x varies while every other variable stays fixed: the slope of the surface in a single direction.

summary.response: The text says differentiation and integration are inverse operations: the integral accumulates area, and its rate of change recovers the original function.

image.response: The graph is concave up where f''(x) > 0 and flattens at the inflection points, where the curvature changes sign.

featureRows.title: How it helps while you read
featureRows.subtitle: Three small moves that change how you understand a document.

understand.title: Understand every page, not just the words
understand.body: {brand} doesn't match text: it understands the meaning of every paragraph, table, image or formula in your document to give you answers with real context.

ask.title: Select and ask, instantly
ask.body: Highlight any passage and ask for an explanation without leaving the page.

notes.title: From reading to notes, without friction
notes.body: When the AI writes a note, you see exactly what changes. Accept, edit or discard each suggestion line by line: the final note is always yours.
notes.before: The derivative is a number that comes out of the function.
notes.after: The derivative measures the instantaneous rate of change of the function at a point.

fileTypes.question: What kind of files can I upload?
fileTypes.answer: Right now we support PDFs of any size. Support for Word documents and presentations is coming soon.

pricing.question: Is it really free?
pricing.answer: {brand} offers a generous free plan that includes document processing and AI notes. We also have a Pro plan for power users.

aiNotes.question: How does the AI work for notes?
aiNotes.answer: We use advanced models that analyze the text you select together with the context of your document to give you accurate, coherent explanations.

images.question: Can I ask about images and formulas?
images.answer: Yes. Select any image, diagram or equation in your PDF and ask about it directly: the AI answers using that image as context.

examMode.question: What is Exam Mode?
examMode.answer: It creates practice exams from the pages you choose, in Practice or Simulation mode, with instant grading.

security.question: Are my documents secure?
security.answer: Yes, privacy is our priority. Your documents are encrypted and only you can access them and your annotations.
